applicability_conditions: Assumes GNDs are uniformly distributed along the x direction, so ∂ρ_GND/∂x = 0 and ∂ρ_GND/∂y ≈ Δρ_GND/Δh; consequently only σ_x, σ_y, and σ_z are non-zero and the back stress is obtained by the von Mises equivalent method; Poisson's ratio ν = 0.28.
latex: \sigma_{\mathrm{b}}\left(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{b}}\right) = \sqrt{16 v^{2} - 16 v + 7} \frac{G b R^{2}}{8 (1 - v)} \cdot \frac{\Delta \rho_{\mathrm{GND}}}{\Delta h}\tag{19}
purpose: Calculates the back stress induced by geometrically necessary dislocations (GNDs) using the von Mises equivalent method.

symbols.meaning: back stress induced by geometrically necessary dislocations (GNDs)
strain (the argument over which the back stress evolves)
average characteristic size of the back stress influence zone

unmapped: The prefactor √(16v² − 16v + 7) arises from the von Mises equivalent combination of the non-zero stress components σ_x, σ_y, σ_z.
In the surrounding text, 'm' is stated as the Poisson's coefficient with ν = 0.28, where 'm' appears to be a typo for ν (written as v in the formula).
Δh is obtained by averaging several TEM structures using the method shown in Fig. 10(a).
